issue.title: The retry button ignores the selected delay
issue.body: Invented example: choose a longer retry delay, save the settings, and trigger a retry. The next attempt still starts after the shortest delay.

expected.brief_md: Make the configured retry delay apply to the next attempt.

issue.title: Long status labels overflow on narrow screens
issue.body: Invented example: on a narrow window, a long status label extends past its card instead of wrapping.

expected.brief_md: Keep long status labels inside their card on narrow screens.

issue.title: A corrected form keeps the old validation message
issue.body: Invented example: submit an invalid value, correct it, and submit again. The form succeeds but leaves the earlier error message visible.

expected.brief_md: Clear stale validation feedback after a corrected form submission succeeds.
